subtitles.line: Welcome to Valhalla~! One rule tonight:
It ends when one dies... or never rises.
Ha! The crow's frozen. He lost.
Eyes are your trap. I won't use mine.
No. He just learned the rule.
Then I'll make you open them.
A giant? Easy win for the crow.
